head.h1: Pool Party Catering in Dubai — Menus, Prices and What's Included

opening_paragraph: Pool party catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person and is cooked poolside by a vetted chef. They grill, plate and serve while you stay by the water. The food is kept light, cold where it should be and quick off the grill, so nothing wilts in the heat and no guest waits in a queue. Give us the date, guest count and venue, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow — no deposit to see the numbers.

new_paragraphs: How much does pool party catering cost in Dubai?

From around AED 700 per person, quoted to your guest count, menu and service. Buffet style is the most affordable per head; plated service with staff sits higher, from about AED 950 per person. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in pool party catering?
Everything: a vetted chef, service staff where needed, plating, setup and the cleanup are all handled for you. You provide the pool and the guests.
Do you offer halal and dietary-friendly pool party menus?
Yes. Every menu is bespoke, so we build halal, vegetarian, vegan, nut-free and gluten-free options into the same table, and cater kids' portions alongside adult dishes.
Can you cater a corporate or large pool party?
Yes. We scale from an intimate poolside dinner to a corporate pool party or wedding reception for large groups, adjusting staffing, stations and timings to the headcount.
How far ahead should I book?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering; book earlier for large parties and peak summer dates, when chefs and weekends fill up fastest.
Do you provide the grill and equipment?
Yes. Your private pool party chef arrives with the cooking equipment and a compact setup, so you do not lose your pool deck, and clears it all away afterwards.
Where in Dubai do you cater pool parties?
Across Dubai — villas, apartments and private residences from Palm Jumeirah to Arabian Ranches — with the same chef standard and food-safety practices everywhere.
What is the cheapest way to do pool party catering in Dubai?

Cheap is a format decision, not a chef decision. Four things move the per-head figure: the service style, since a self-serve buffet costs less per head than plated service with dedicated staff; how long the serving window runs; how many live stations you want going at once; and whether the menu leans on premium cuts and seafood or on grilled chicken, kofta, halloumi and a generous cold table, which eat just as well beside a pool. A shorter afternoon with one grill station is where most budgets land, and the quote is itemised so you can see which line to cut.
Can you do an Indian menu for a small pool party?

Yes. Indian food suits a pool deck: tandoori chicken and paneer tikka come off the same grill as the kofta, chaat and kachumber work as cold plates, and a biryani holds its heat in a covered tray better than most mains do. For a small party catering booking we keep the spread tight — three or four grill items, two or three cold dishes and one rice — instead of a full banquet nobody finishes. See Indian catering in Dubai for the wider range.
Do you cater kids' birthday pool parties?

Yes, and poolside is one of the most common settings for one. A kids' birthday party catering brief runs on smaller portions, familiar food — sliders, chicken skewers, fruit platters and frozen desserts — and a serving window timed around swimming instead of one sit-down moment. Adults eat off the same grill with a sharper menu alongside, so you are not running two events at once. Tell us the ages and we size the portions and the timings to them.

We bring luxury pool party catering to villas, apartments and private residences right across the city — Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills, Dubai Hills, Jumeirah, JVC, Arabian Ranches and the Marina towers with pool decks — and the service travels the same whether it is an intimate home gathering or a large celebration. Pool party home catering in a private garden and a rooftop event in Downtown get the same vetted chef, the same food-safety standards and the same itemised quote. add_block.new_heading: What does pool party catering in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: Pool party catering services in Dubai from myCHEF cover the whole job end to end: menu design, a chef cooking on site, service staff where the guest count needs them, plus setup and cleanup so your terrace looks the same after as before. A private pool party chef arrives with the equipment, fires the grill or builds the stations, keeps cold dishes cold and hot dishes moving, then clears every plate, tray and bin bag on the way out. You are not renting a drop-off tray you have to plate yourself — this is full-service catering built for a home, villa or rooftop pool, where the kitchen is small and the real room is outside. Everything runs to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements , including holding temperatures that matter far more beside a warm pool than they do in an air-conditioned dining room.

add_block.new_heading: Pool party catering for weddings, corporate and private parties
new_paragraphs: The same team scales from an intimate poolside dinner to a full-day event, so pool party catering for events in Dubai looks different depending on who is coming. A private party for friends leans casual: sharing platters, a live grill and a mocktail station people graze from all afternoon. Corporate pool party catering — a summer team day, a client sundowner, a villa offsite — usually wants tidier canapés, a clear serving window and staff who keep drinks moving without hovering. Poolside wedding receptions and engagement drinks sit at the premium end, where plated courses or chef-manned stations turn the water's edge into the centrepiece. Tell us the occasion and the headcount and we shape the format, the staffing and the menu around it, instead of handing you one fixed package and hoping it fits.

add_block.new_heading: Pool party menu ideas and options
new_paragraphs: A good pool party menu in Dubai is built for heat, hands and movement — food guests can eat standing, without cutlery, that holds its texture out of the fridge. Typical starting points include:
BBQ and grill stations — marinated chicken, lamb kofta, prawns, halloumi and grilled vegetables cooked to order
fresh salads and light bites — watermelon and feta, tabbouleh, ceviche, chilled soups and dips
sliders, wraps and finger food that stay quick to hold poolside
mocktails, fresh juices and frozen desserts to close the afternoon

Every pool party food menu is bespoke — these are only prompts. We adapt for halal requirements, vegetarian and vegan guests, nut and gluten allergies and kids, so one table works for the whole group. Share your taste and any dietary needs and the chef designs around them.

add_block.new_heading: Poolside logistics and keeping food safe in the heat
new_paragraphs: Heat is the one thing that separates a pool party from an indoor dinner, and it drives every choice we make. Cold dishes stay on ice and chilled service ware; grilled items are cooked in timed batches so the food reaches guests hot and fresh instead of sitting out; and shaded prep and holding areas keep everything within safe temperature ranges through a long afternoon. The chef and any service staff work from your kitchen or a compact mobile setup, so you do not lose your pool deck to catering gear. We plan drinks, ice and waste around the venue, whether that is a JVC villa garden, a Palm rooftop or an apartment building's shared pool with its own access rules. If your building has restrictions on open flame or delivery times, we work within them.

new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the day, we carry the work. No chef is offered for pool party catering before clearing identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard instead of a one-time tick. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef well suited to it.

For relaxed, grill-led poolside food that leans Italian and Mediterranean, that is often Marco Rossi , who builds sharing menus around the fire — charred vegetables, seafood and skewers that look generous on a long table and eat well in the sun. When an occasion calls for classical fine dining instead, Ahmed Al-Rashid , with 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris, designs each menu as a collaboration with the host. We have run pool party catering alongside villa weddings, yacht celebrations and corporate galas across Dubai — including a poolside summer party for 60 guests in Dubai Hills run entirely from the villa's own kitchen —. Client reviews are added as events run.
